messages:
jamie: quick q — we hit a repro where responses sometimes truncate. Can I temporarily capture full request+response bodies in staging for 48h? Would prefer to hash emails and strip tokens, but need to capture headers to correlate calls.

sara: don't capture full bearer tokens anywhere. :no_entry_sign:
Hash PII (emails/user ids) with HMAC-SHA256 + KMS key — that keeps detector data usable.
If you need headers for correlation, capture only a small allowlist: `x-request-id`, `x-client-version`, `x-region`. Drop `authorization`, `cookie`, `set-cookie`.
For bodies, store only `input_text` and `model_response` after running a scrub pipeline.

mike: can you paste the scrub pipeline snippet? want to hook into our staging collector.

sara: sure. example:
```
rules:
  - path: headers.authorization
    action: redact
  - path: headers.email
    action: replace_with_hash
  - path: body.prompt
    action: scrub_personal_info
retention: 24h
transport: s3-encrypted
```
Also: request an ephemeral capture ticket and include which trace ids + time window. Sec oncall will review.

security-bot: [policy] Logging & Data Capture — https://redwood.internal/policies/logging-data-capture

alex: this is pretty urgent — it's blocking a customer. any fast-track? can SE + engs get temporary sign-off?

sara: fast-track is possible for <72h captures if you: open ticket in #sec-requests, include justification, time window, and data minimization plan. tag `@oncall-sec` and `@privacy`. We'll aim same-day review.

jamie: ok i'll open ticket now and add trace ids. thanks :heart:

mike: adding minimal list of trace ids in the ticket: trace-20260310-03..03, trace-20260309-22..44

sara: received — will ping when reviewed.
